steps.name: Verify safe AU installer in temporary directories
Install and validate the user AU
Render and restore the actual VST3
Restore embedded state in the actual AU
Verify safe AU installer in temporary directories
Initialize pinned native SDK and JSON header
Check built Windows resources (EXE is not distributed)
Package Universal staging copies with ad-hoc signatures
Verify exact packaged AU and VST3
Verify and unpack the same Universal candidate on Intel
Run packaged Intel AU/VST3 and auval
Prepare isolated signing and notary credentials
Sign, notarize and staple the Universal candidate
Remove temporary credentials on every exit
Upload public signing and notarization records
Verify and extract the final signed DMG
Exercise the exact signed AU and VST3
Verify and extract the final signed DMG
Exercise the exact signed AU and VST3

notes: Native SDK uses an immutable public commit after v0.1.6, including SPU Gaussian/headroom corrections, allocation-free reverb clear and live edits to two independent private host PCM banks, plus bounded long-host-PCM event distances and independent ADPCM loop flags; it is not a published v0.1.7 release.
VST3 SDK v3.8.0_build_66. Only base, pluginterfaces, public.sdk and cmake submodules are needed.
Gitlinks are authoritative. Never update a dependency to moving master as part of a normal build.
